text:
marta: Quick huddle — OurCloud marketplace launch: final go/no-go checklist. Need signoffs on press embargo, marketplace tile copy, hardware partner co-branding, SI onboarding doc, and analytics. Owners?

aaron: I can take embargo + press list. Proposed embargo 11:00 PT Tue. Thoughts?

sree: prefer Wed 09:00 PT to align with partner PR ops. Wed better for APAC too.

kate: Wed 09:00 PT works for me. I'll own marketplace listing copy + CTAs.

lee: hardware partner (AccelBoard) needs logo treatment + partner quote. I've asked design for dark/light variants.

buildbot: Deploy: staging.marketplace.redwood/ourcloud-accelboard (build 5120) — smoke passed.

marta: Kate, include a short code snippet showing hosted vs dedicated usage. Lee — can AccelBoard confirm logo by Mon EOD?

lee: AccelBoard legal asked for 48h. ETA Mon 18:00 PT.

aaron: Press timeline (draft):
T-7 Mon: finalize copy + quotes
T-5 Wed: partner logo approvals
T-3 Fri: marketing QA + UTMs
T-1 Tue: embargo brief sent to press
Publish Wed 09:00 PT

sree: UTMs — use utm_campaign=ourcloud-accelboard-2026. Analytics events: marketplace_click, partner_signup, marketplace_cta.

kate: CTA text: "Deploy on Redwood" and secondary "Contact AccelBoard". Hero image 1400x560 png, 2MB max.

marta: SI onboarding doc items: connector versions, required ports, SCIM/SSO notes, estimated ramp (3 weeks), support handoff. Who drafts?

lee: I'll draft the SI one-pager with AccelBoard contact + handoff checklist.

kate: Copy tweak: legal flagged "unlimited scale". Replace with "scales with demand".

buildbot: build 5120 deployed to staging with cropped tile 1200x300. Internal link: https://staging.redwood/marketplace/ourcloud-accelboard (internal)

marta: Blockers: partner quote, logo approvals, final hero. If not cleared by Tue 12:00 PT we shift embargo by 24h.

aaron: I'll assemble embargo pack and target press list today. Need final partner quote by Mon.

sree: Pinged product for benchmark snippets — will request p50/p95 and one embedding throughput stat for bullets.

marta: Owners recap:
- aaron: embargo + press list (due today EOD)
- kate: listing copy + hero (due Mon EOD)
- lee: partner assets + SI draft (due Mon EOD)
- sree: benchmarks + analytics events (due Mon EOD)

kate: I'll add canonical link from blog to marketplace listing and include press kit zip on partner page.

marta: Thanks all. Quick sync Tue 11:00 PT if we have blockers, otherwise post updates here. :rocket:
